Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner erroneously concluded that the Cairo Declaration film came out first, relying on a mistaken interpretation that a film titled "Cairo Declaration" was released in 1943. This error stemmed from misunderstanding the results where the actual 2015 Chinese film titled "Cairo Declaration" was consistently quoted with a release year of 2015 across multiple credible sources. The mistake occurred due to a misalignment in synthesizing verified release years and incorrectly assuming the film’s relation to the historical event of the Cairo Declaration conference in 1943.
